source_artifact_requirement.q_per_world_shape: [M, 7], oracle Q per action slot before PDF collapse

leakage_boundary.allowed: Use hidden holder truth only in offline labels, reports, calibration targets, and evaluation.
leakage_boundary.forbidden: Do not feed true hidden ownership as a live feature to Gus, Burl, or any gameplay selector.
leakage_boundary.online_replacement: A live model may predict beliefs from legal public state; the impact labels only weight and evaluate those beliefs offline.

row_grain: one decision, one legal action, one hidden domino, one candidate holder

thresholds.notes: These first-pass thresholds mirror the bid-30 make/set cliff used by the E[Q] PDF visualizer and action selection code. A later bid-aware schema should set thresholds from bid_value.

fields.seed: source seed when present in payload.seeds
fields.decision_idx: zero-based decision index within the generated game
fields.action_domino_id: visible domino id for action_slot when game.hands is present
fields.hidden_domino_id: candidate unseen domino id from world_hands
fields.relative_holder: 0,1,2 for next opponent, partner/opposite, previous opponent relative to actor
fields.world_count: number of sampled worlds for this decision
fields.conditioned_world_count: worlds where this holder owns this hidden domino
fields.baseline_mean_q: mean q_per_world for this action across all worlds
fields.conditioned_mean_q: mean q_per_world for this action where holder owns the hidden domino
fields.conditioned_tail_low_mass: P(Q <= tail_low_q | holder owns hidden domino)
fields.conditioned_shelf_high_mass: P(Q >= shelf_high_q | holder owns hidden domino)

candidate_metrics.name: threshold_mass_delta_by_hidden_holder
candidate_metrics.definition: conditioned_shelf_high_mass - baseline_shelf_high_mass and conditioned_tail_low_mass - baseline_tail_low_mass grouped by hidden_domino_id and absolute_holder
candidate_metrics.use: Find unseen holdings that explain make/set shelves or disaster tails.

candidate_metrics.name: outcome_mean_delta_by_hidden_holder
candidate_metrics.use: Rank holder/domino pairs by expected outcome impact.

candidate_metrics.name: top_k_hidden_holdings_by_abs_impact
candidate_metrics.definition: top rows per decision/action by impact_score
candidate_metrics.use: Inspectable labels for reports and trace review.

candidate_metrics.name: impact_weighted_belief_calibration
candidate_metrics.definition: belief error for a hidden holder/domino assignment weighted by abs(mean_q_delta) and threshold-mass deltas
candidate_metrics.use: Evaluate whether learned beliefs concentrate probability on tactically important uncertainty, not just average ownership.

known_gaps: The first-pass script uses fixed thresholds and should become bid-aware when bid_value is consistently present.
Aggregate E[Q] PDFs alone cannot support this attribution; q_per_world and world_hands must be regenerated or preserved.
Posterior-weighted saved worlds need explicit per-world weights before weighted attribution can be exact.
